content.short: Eigenpie is a specialized Liquid Restaking platform by Magpie, offering isolated LRT solutions for EigenLayer.
content.description:
Eigenpie is an innovative Liquid Restaking platform created by Magpie to provide specialized services within the EigenLayer ecosystem. It focuses on offering isolated Liquid Restaking Token (LRT) solutions, allowing users to restake their assets without sacrificing liquidity or security. By supporting a wide array of Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs), Eigenpie enables participants to earn rewards from both the underlying staking and the restaking process, all while maintaining a flexible and user-friendly experience.

The protocol is designed to maximize capital efficiency and risk management through its isolated architecture. This approach ensures that risks associated with specific assets are contained, providing a safer environment for depositors. As a key sub-DAO within the Magpie ecosystem, Eigenpie leverages cross-chain capabilities to bring advanced restaking opportunities to a broader audience, reinforcing the infrastructure of decentralized finance.
